cheap_screens: coverage_preflight: require at least 60% non-null history for pb_history_756d and pe_ttm_history_756d before any workflow
information_screen: compare percentile bucket forward-return monotonicity on cached data only, no queue write
risk_screen: reject if best cheap-screen bucket pair implies max-drawdown worse than the current -0.35 limit proxy
routes.economic_mechanism: A stock that is cheap relative to its own multi-year history may represent a more comparable valuation dislocation than cross-sectional cheapness alone, especially after industry-relative value failed drawdown gates.
falsification_criteria: long valuation history coverage below 60% after data load
historical cheapness buckets show no positive rank-order relation to forward returns in a cheap screen
middle or cheap bucket advantage disappears after industry-neutral grouping
drawdown proxy remains worse than -0.35 even for the best non-extreme bucket pair

cheap_screens: pit_safety_screen: reject if announcement-date alignment cannot prove data was known before portfolio date
coverage_preflight: require sufficient forecast coverage by industry and date before factor generation
event_window_screen: test only post-announcement cached rows for simple revision direction and dispersion, no full backtest
routes.economic_mechanism: Valuation repair is more plausible when cheap stocks also receive improving earnings expectations or positive forecast revisions; this is economically distinct from mechanical value plus price momentum.
falsification_criteria: announcement-date point-in-time alignment is unavailable or ambiguous
forecast/revision coverage is too sparse by date or industry
positive revision among cheap names does not improve cheap-screen hit rate versus cheap-only baseline
revision signal collapses after excluding micro-cap or high-turnover names

cheap_screens: coverage_preflight: verify cashflow and leverage fields exist with point-in-time report dates
distress_bucket_screen: check whether excluding worst leverage/cashflow buckets reduces drawdown proxy before any full workflow
neutralization_screen: require improvement not explained solely by size or industry grouping
routes.economic_mechanism: The current value-trap problem may be driven by distressed cheap stocks. Cash conversion, leverage, and profitability stability should separate recoverable value from value traps before any portfolio construction repair is trusted.
falsification_criteria: cashflow/leverage fields are unavailable or not point-in-time safe
distress exclusion does not reduce drawdown proxy versus current value-quality route
screened cheap basket loses all positive IC or bucket-spread evidence
coverage remains below the route threshold after data enrichment
